title: Guided Onboarding Checklist (Hosted API) — Beta Retrospective (2026-03)
author: Dylan Brooks
body:
## Summary
We ran a feature-flagged beta of the in-product Guided Onboarding Checklist for Hosted API (Console) to reduce time-to-first-success (TTFS) and make the path to a first production launch more reliable and measurable.

Overall outcome: the checklist materially improved early activation for new signups and reduced common support escalations (401 wrong key / 429 confusion). Telemetry quality was “good enough to iterate” but not yet at GA bar due to intermittent missing events in one region and a small number of idempotency/deduplication gaps.

This retro captures: what worked, what didn’t, telemetry findings, and prioritized follow-ups.

---

## Beta scope
**In scope (Beta):**
- Hosted API onboarding checklist UI in Console behind feature flag
- Server-side checklist state (per org + per project)
- Validation signals for:
  - API key created
  - First successful request (200/201 responses)
  - First streaming session
  - Usage dashboard visit
  - Prod-mode API key created
- Deep links from steps → canonical docs URLs (with UTM tags)
- Onboarding telemetry schema v1 emitted from Console + backend

**Out of scope (Beta):**
- Dedicated/Private onboarding
- Automated validation for all production-readiness items (timeouts, retries, rollback, etc.)
- SSO/SAML onboarding

---

## Cohort + rollout details
- **Beta window:** 2026-03-03 to 2026-03-20
- **Eligibility:** new orgs created after 2026-03-03; plus a small allowlist of 18 existing orgs for feedback
- **Exposure:** 12% of eligible new orgs (randomized) + allowlist
- **Regions:** primarily us-east-1 and eu-west-1; a small portion of traffic routed via ap-southeast-1 due to customer geo
- **Kill switch:** `console.guided_onboarding_checklist` feature flag (admin override available)

---

## Success criteria (beta learning goals)
We treated beta as a learning milestone; the GA criteria is tracked separately.

Learning goals:
1) Validate that checklist improves TTFS and reduces early drop-off.
2) Identify which steps are confusing or misordered.
3) Validate telemetry event schema v1 can power a funnel dashboard without collecting sensitive data.

---

## Key metrics (beta readout)
Notes:
- Metrics below are for *new orgs in the beta cohort* vs a matched holdout cohort (same signup window, same regions), excluding internal Redwood orgs.
- Time-based metrics use the first event timestamp seen in our onboarding dataset; see “Telemetry limitations” for caveats.

| Metric | Holdout | Beta cohort | Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Median time: signup → first successful request | 11m 40s | 7m 55s | -32% |
| P75 time: signup → first successful request | 38m 10s | 24m 05s | -37% |
| % reaching first successful request within 30 min | 61% | 74% | +13 pts |
| % completing checklist “Basics” section within 24h | 28% | 41% | +13 pts |
| % creating a prod-mode API key within 7 days | 9% | 14% | +5 pts |
| Support tickets tagged onboarding/401 wrong key (per 1k signups) | 18.2 | 11.6 | -36% |

Step-level completion (beta cohort, within 24h of signup):
- Create API key: **86%**
- Make first request (validated): **74%**
- Try streaming (validated): **31%**
- Visit Usage dashboard (client event): **22%**
- Create prod-mode key: **12%**

Primary drop-off points:
- Between “First request” → “Streaming”
- Between “Streaming” → “Usage dashboard”

---

## What worked well
### 1) Checklist UX reduced “blank page” problem
- Users reported the checklist made the Console feel actionable immediately after signup.
- The “deep link to docs + return to Console” pattern performed well; most users returned to complete additional steps within the same session.

### 2) Validation for “first successful request” was a high-signal step
- The validator based on gateway request logs (with a short expected lag) was accurate enough for beta.
- Support feedback: fewer cases of “I think I called the API but nothing happened” because the step completion served as confirmation.

### 3) Prod vs test API key labeling measurably reduced 401 confusion
- Support and customer interviews strongly validated the “wrong environment key” failure mode.
- Distinguishing test/prod keys plus step copy (“use prod key in deployed apps”) reduced repeated misconfiguration.

### 4) Cross-functional operating model held up
- Weekly beta triage (PM + Console + DevEx + Docs + Support + Security) kept copy, validation logic, and docs in sync.
- Clear ownership improved iteration speed (Console team owned feature flag + state; DevEx owned code examples; Docs owned canonical URLs).

---

## What didn’t work / friction points
### 1) Streaming step copy and expectations were unclear
Observed issues:
- Users interpreted “Try streaming” as “required for production,” not “recommended capability.”
- Some users attempted streaming first (before a non-streaming request) due to step order in quickstart templates.

Impact:
- Increased confusion during first session; some users hit streaming disconnects and churned without trying a basic request.

### 2) Usage dashboard step wasn’t compelling enough
- The step CTA (“View usage analytics”) was perceived as “billing” and postponed.
- Users wanted a clearer “why” (debugging, latency, token costs) and a 30-second “what you’ll see” preview.

### 3) Validation lag + partial failures caused mistrust
- In ~6% of cases, “First successful request” completion lag exceeded 90 seconds due to pipeline delay.
- A small subset of users refreshed or retried repeatedly, which created frustration and some duplicate support pings.

### 4) Checklist state reset behavior wasn’t obvious
- Support used the admin reset tool successfully, but the user-facing experience after reset was confusing (“why did my progress disappear?”).
- We need clearer messaging and a safer support workflow.

---

## Telemetry findings
### Telemetry health
- Schema v1 is workable for funnel analysis, but we found two gaps that must be addressed before GA:
  1) **Regional missing events**: ap-southeast-1 intermittently dropped `onboarding.step_viewed` and `onboarding.step_completed` events for ~2.5 hours on 2026-03-12.
     - Tracked under internal support ticket INT-3321; root cause was a misconfigured allowlist in one collector deployment.
  2) **Dedupe gaps**: `onboarding.checklist_viewed` occasionally emitted twice per session due to route transitions + optimistic render.
     - Not catastrophic for funnels (we de-duped in queries), but it erodes confidence.

### Funnel insights (from telemetry + session replays)
- The highest-converting path was:
  - Create key → first request → troubleshooting doc visit (if needed) → first request completes → return to checklist
- Users who visited troubleshooting docs had a higher completion rate of “First request” (self-serve fixes), but *lower* streaming completion (they often stopped after success).

### Privacy/security validation
- Security review constraints were upheld:
  - No prompt content captured
  - Property allowlist respected
  - Request IDs are treated as operational identifiers and not joined to customer payloads
- Action needed: update retention tags for onboarding events to align with the final policy documented in the privacy review.

---

## Customer/support feedback highlights
From Support + beta check-ins:
- Top resolved pain points:
  - Wrong key environment (401)
  - “Where do I start?”
- Top remaining pain points:
  - Rate limit (429) confusion: users want a concrete snippet for retry/backoff and a clear explanation of quotas vs rate limits.
  - Streaming disconnects: users want recommended defaults (timeouts/keepalive) and a canonical “known-good” snippet per SDK.

---

## Decisions made during retro
1) **Reorder steps** so that streaming is explicitly optional and comes after a stable “first request” + “error handling” concept.
2) **Strengthen the “Usage dashboard” step** with clearer value (latency/token cost debugging) and a short preview panel.
3) **GA telemetry bar**: do not proceed to GA until (a) regional collector config is audited and (b) event dedupe is enforced at source for the known double-emit routes.
4) **Ship one canonical retry/timeout snippet per SDK** and link it from the checklist (rather than burying it only in docs).

---

## Prioritized follow-ups (next 2–6 weeks)
### P0 (blockers for GA)
1) **Telemetry reliability: regional configuration audit + alerts**
   - Owner: Nadia Rahman (Telemetry)
   - Deliverable: collector deployment config audit checklist + automated conformance check; alerting on missing events per region
   - Success: <0.5% missing onboarding events per day per region; alert within 10 minutes of anomaly

2) **Fix known double-emission paths**
   - Owner: Hannah Rivera (Console)
   - Deliverable: ensure `checklist_viewed` and `step_viewed` are emitted once per route render (idempotency key tied to session + route + step)

3) **Retention tags aligned to privacy review**
   - Owner: Marcus Lin (Security) + Logan Wright (Telemetry platform)
   - Deliverable: update retention configuration and document in the event schema page

### P1 (high impact activation improvements)
4) **Streaming step rewrite + reposition**
   - Owner: Kenji Nakamura (Design) + Wei Chen (Docs)
   - Change: rename to “Optional: Stream responses” and add “Start with a basic request first” microcopy

5) **Add “Handle 429s and retries” checklist step (education + snippet)**
   - Owner: Monica Patel (SDK) + Nikhil Sharma (PM)
   - Deliverable: short docs page + snippet parity across Python/TS/Go; link from Console; include guidance on quota vs rate limit

6) **Improve “Usage dashboard” motivation and add lightweight preview**
   - Owner: Marissa Cole (PM) + Console team
   - Deliverable: updated step description + small UI preview (“see token spend, latency, errors”) + direct deep link

### P2 (quality + operability)
7) **User-facing messaging for validation lag**
   - Owner: Tessa Morgan (Design)
   - Deliverable: “This can take up to ~2 minutes” status + non-blocking UI; avoid encouraging refresh loops

8) **Support workflow for checklist reset**
   - Owner: Dev Patel (Support) + Chloe Martin (Console backend)
   - Deliverable: support macro + improved audit logging and a user-visible banner when progress is reset

9) **Documentation link governance (redirects + version-stable URLs)**
   - Owner: Elliot Price (Docs)
   - Deliverable: redirect policy and automated link checker for checklist URLs

---

## Risks / watch-outs
- **Metric interpretation risk:** TTFS improvements are sensitive to telemetry lag and attribution; keep a holdout cohort and validate with request-log-based measurement.
- **Over-checklisting risk:** adding too many steps could reduce completion; keep Phase 1 checklist minimal and progressive.
- **Regional rollout risk:** missing telemetry in a region can silently break dashboards; must have per-region health signals and paging thresholds.

---

## Appendix A — Notable incidents during beta
1) **INT-3321: Missing onboarding events in ap-southeast-1 (2026-03-12)**
   - Symptom: funnel completion appeared to drop to near-zero for the region
   - Mitigation: rolled back collector config; reprocessed partial backlog where possible
   - Follow-up: P0 telemetry configuration audit + alerting
